Project: MEEEM Multi-Vendor Platform

Target Platform: AWS Amplify / Docker / Production VPS

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1. CRITICAL NOTICE FOR DEVOPS / SERVER ADMINISTRATORS
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
RSA Private Keys in PEM format contain 30+ lines with newlines. In CI/CD pipelines
like AWS Amplify, writing multiline environment variables into `.env` using shell 
commands (e.g. `echo "KEY=$KEY" >> .env`) truncates everything after the first 
line (`-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----`), breaking the key.

To prevent this issue, we provide the EXACT private key encoded as a SINGLE-LINE 
Base64 string (`FLOT_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64`). The application code automatically decodes 
and cryptographically verifies it at runtime.
